modifiedSource: Clean frozen runtime commit recorded in provenance; only edit_code description changes.
intervention: T2: clarify the existing kind/action discriminator with one symbolic JSON example in the edit_code description. No schema, executor, source-coverage, validation, skill metadata, recovery, read description or native tool change.
taskSelection: Three newly authored cases selected after the first four completed T2 canary trials, before their own outcomes and before global execution. They do not select or modify the fixed T2 intervention. Separate fixture/evaluator; internal unblinded confirmation, not an external population sample.
transport: Configured BLAME API/openai-codex; no artificial interruption; auth values never archived
environment: Same Linux x64 worker, pinned installed dependencies, fresh identical fixture per paired task; no memory or solution retrieval. Provider nondeterminism, retries and cache are uncontrolled.

budget.policy: Existing USD 0.05 per-trial SDK estimate guard; stop starting trials at the registered panel observed estimate. Canary and global guards are separate. Not invoice caps; keep all missing usage and unexecuted planned trials.

ordering: Unchanged driver: manifest order in repetition one; reversed task and arm order in repetition two. Arm rotation uses the full task index, so indices >=3 retain base arm order. Sequential, no replacement or outcome-driven stopping.
quality: Audited literal instruction criteria AND successful runtime completion; preserve original weighted score, functional checks, required post-edit root build, admission and termination separately. Every source/input reviewed without repair, solution retrieval or agent feedback. Bounded evaluator self-checks before model trials; no old date/reducer/CSS conventions apply.
accounting: Observe input+output tokens as primary efficiency, with task-matched audited-completion AND usage-reconciled pairs, plus whole-panel success/failure resources. Cache tokens are subsets of input; reasoning is a subset of output; do not double count. Preserve timeouts and missing request/cache/provider usage. Report task-cluster paired uncertainty. Category bytes measure repeated context exposure, not billed tokens; native categories absent.
decision: Execute canary then the fixed full panel irrespective of favorable efficiency outcomes unless regression, access or configured guards block execution. Mechanism endpoint: invalid kind discriminator attempts per planned Light trial, all edit-block reasons and model/tool calls. Resource endpoint: completed-success and usage-reconciled task-matched total tokens, SDK cost estimates and duration with task-cluster uncertainty. Retain if mechanism helps without an observed quality loss; an inconclusive or adverse result is published and does not establish benefit. Prefix overhead, excessive symbolic body replacements and omitted patch choices are regression risks; guards remain active.
